name: CompTIA Linux+
realExamNote: The real exam has up to 90 questions in 90 minutes, including performance-based questions; the practice exams here are multiple choice only (use the Labs tab for hands-on practice). XK0-006 (Linux+ V8) launched July 15, 2025, replacing XK0-005.
scoreNote: CompTIA's real scoring is scaled differently, so treat 720+ as a readiness signal, not a guarantee.
